generated_note: Maps every datagen dataset in spec_files/ to the fallback test cases (in cloudcp_fallback_test.py / plan_cp_fallback.md) that exercise it, and what each case verifies. File counts are the deterministic geometry from each spec.

F3.meaning: Every record fails the primary path.

F6.meaning: Every record crashes the primary worker.

expectation_kinds.fallback_ok: Faulted profile, fallback ON -> transfer COMPLETED, retry/list files observed, FALLBACK_OK rows in report, all files transferred.
expectation_kinds.control: F0, fallback ON -> COMPLETED with all SUCCESS, no FALLBACK_OK, no retry lists.
expectation_kinds.must_fail: Faulted profile, FALLBACK_ENABLED=False -> transfer must end in terminal FAILURE.
expectation_kinds.clean_fail: Invalid target -> fail cleanly (init reject or terminal failure), no crash/hang.

datasets.description: 200 zero-length files. Exercises empty-object / zero-length PUT handling.
datasets.fallback_focus: Confirms the fallback path correctly re-drives empty-object records (a common edge that can be silently skipped).

mapped_cases.tests: Baseline zero-byte upload with no fault; must succeed cleanly with no fallback engaged.
All empty-object records fail the primary path; fallback must carry every zero-byte record.
Same all-fail zero tier but with HI_PERF_OPT off (minimum acceptance).
Invalid/nonexistent destination bucket; must fail cleanly with no crash/hang (uses zero tier as the cheapest payload).
